title: Chapter 1485
text:
The meeting between the two parties did not last long. In the end, the date was set to nine years later. Without the knowledge of the entire galactic society, the new fate of the dark side universe they were in was finalized.

Countless galactic residents were still immersed in a peaceful and happy life. In a place they could not see, the three Universal Civilizations and Han Xiao were silently preparing for the True Form transformation of the dark side universe. Day by day, the date of the official implementation of the plan was approaching.

In the long-awaited era of peace, the days passed quickly. The stars moved, the sun rose, and the moon set. Time flowed like water, never to return. Nine years passed quietly as the various large organizations rested. The galactic society had already changed, and a new generation of young people had grown up. However, it seemed like nothing had changed. The three Universal Civilizations, the Supers Holy Land, and the Supercluster Alliance were still entrenched in one area.

Today was the agreed date, and it was also the starting point of the dark side universe's fate.

In the Central Galaxy, the three Universal Civilizations had specially built a military restricted zone for this day.

Countless Information Form reaction enhancement devices formed a dense and neat array in the starry sky. They were distributed layer by layer, forming a sphere. Han Xiao was at the center of all the auxiliary device arrays, floating alone in space.

In the distance, the fleets of the three Universal Civilizations surrounded him layer after layer as guards to prevent any accidents from disturbing Han Xiao's transformation.

In the main ship, the remote projections of the three Rulers looked at Han Xiao outside the porthole with solemn expressions.

"Your Excellency Black Star, we're all ready. Please …"

Marbruce paused, took a deep breath, and said in the communication channel.

"Let's begin."

"… Okay."

Han Xiao's expression was calm as he responded softly with a complicated look in his eyes.

Although he had rehearsed for this day more than once in the past nine years, he could not help but feel emotional when it actually happened.

The plan to transform the dark side universe was still a secret of the upper echelons. The three Universal Civilizations hoped to quietly solve this ultimate problem that involved the truth of the universe while countless galactic residents were asleep. It would be best if the dark side universe and the real universe overlapped without anyone noticing. Therefore, Han Xiao only told the relevant information to Ames and a few other trustworthy people. The others continued to live as usual on this day.

Han Xiaoxin's psyche sank into his body, and his chest slowly glowed as if it had turned into a white space tunnel. The space here was folding and contracting.

Soon, in a dazzling white light, the World Tree that had taken root in the inner space appeared in the outside world. It emitted a vibrant green light and spun around.

Han Xiao lowered his head and looked at the miniature figure of the Tree of World. His mind was already connected, and he could activate the Information Materialization function at any time. But at this moment, he stopped, and the look in his eyes changed.

Information anchor points flashed in his head one after another. Rippling illusions seemed to be popping up in front of his eyes. He seemed to be reviewing his bizarre, magnificent life in the past hundred years from the perspective of a third person.

In the end, the image was fixed on countless familiar figures. There were old acquaintances, enemies who had passed away, and friends who were still in the present …

"I hope that everything that has happened here can anchor my existence. Don't let me forget … that I've been here before."

The next moment, Han Xiao no longer hesitated and activated the Information Materialization function of the Tree of World.

Hum!

As if the universe had just been born, Han Xiao's figure was instantly drowned in light. It was as if endless light sprayed out, filling everyone's vision.

At this moment, everyone in the entire galactic society felt something and subconsciously thought of Black Star.

…

On the top floor of the palace on Floating Dragon Island …

Ames stood on the balcony with her hands behind her back, looking up at the bright galaxy in the sky. Her long hair and black dress fluttered in the wind like dancing black flames.

"Mommy, I thought of Daddy just now …"

A childish voice sounded behind her, and a little girl in a little skirt ran out of the room. She stumbled on the way and almost fell.

This little girl was about seven or eight years old. She looked like she was carved from jade, and her face was a little chubby. Her eyes were black and bright like gems, and she looked lively and cute. She was the only child she had with Han Xiao.

Ames turned around, and a doting expression appeared on her face. She bent over and hugged her daughter. She scratched her little nose and chuckled softly. "I miss Daddy too."

The little girl hugged Ames' arm and stayed comfortably in her embrace. She blinked her big eyes and said with a little grievance, "Daddy hasn't come for a long time.

"Dad hasn't come to see me for a long time. Where did he go?"

"He's doing a great job."

Ames smiled faintly.

"Then, when will Daddy come back?" The little girl's eyes widened, and curiosity overflowed.

"I don't know either …"

Ames shook her head. She hugged her daughter with one hand and pointed at the deep starry sky with the other as she chuckled.

"But no matter where he is, he will definitely look after you. When you grow up, he will come back."

…

Real universe, solar system, behind Neptune.

A small exploration space station covered in a black and blue coating was quietly suspended in outer space. It was disguised as a meteorite and looked inconspicuous.

At this moment, in the observation room of the space station, several intelligent creatures in heavy spacesuits were adjusting instruments. Their body structure was similar to that of humans, but they had hard skin covered with spikes. They were short, with an average height of only about 1.3 meters.

Most of these instruments were long-range observation instruments. Above the instruments were densely packed screens, and on them were scenes of bustling cities on Earth.

At this moment, one of the hard-shelled men in the room turned on the video recorder, cleared his throat, and spoke in his unique language. He said:

"Text message recording of the 27081 star time. The behavior of today's observation target is as usual. There are no abnormalities. We have not been discovered. End."

"Another boring day ~"

A thin, hard-shelled man next to him interrupted. He stretched in his seat, and the hard shell and bones all over his body emitted a crackling sound.

The person who was recording the video seemed to be the captain. Without turning his head, he replied solemnly:

"No abnormalities are the best news. Our job is to ensure that the observation target does not have a technological explosion before the arrival of the follow-up troops and develop an interstellar weapon that is enough to threaten us."

"Yes, yes, yes. I was just complaining. I really hope that the next shift will come soon. I'd rather freeze and sleep than keep an eye on this weak surface civilization every star time … Sigh, I really want to go home."

The thin, hard-shelled man who had spoken earlier sounded helpless.

This group of intelligent creatures did not belong to this area. They were distant guests from other galaxies, from the Kabang civilization.

In order to search for alien civilizations, the Kabang civilization sent teams of explorers into the galaxy. They took exploration spaceships that had always been hidden and camouflaged, drifting in the universe for a long time. All the crew members were in frozen hibernation. When they discovered traces of civilization, the intelligent system of the spaceship would automatically wake up the hibernating crew members.

This group of Kabang people was one of the interstellar explorers. Many years ago, when they came to the Solar System, the spaceship discovered the probes sent by the Earth civilization into outer space, so they woke up the team. This team used the detection equipment on the spaceship to lock onto the Earth civilization. Then, they chose a remote location and turned the spaceship into a small space station. They completed a further disguise and hid there.

This group of Kabang explorers adhered to the principle of non-interference, non-communication, and non-exposure. They silently waited in the Solar System and used the interstellar observation equipment on the spaceship to monitor Earth for a long time. They had never been discovered.

"Stop complaining and pay more attention to your mission." The captain of the Kabang explorers turned off the video recorder and suddenly paused. "However, the main force is only 580 star hours away from us. We won't have to monitor them for too long before we're free."

"That's true. I really want to end the mission as soon as possible. I really can't stand eating these nutrition pastes every day. I really want to go back and eat something good …" The skinny Kabang team member said with longing.

This team of explorers had long sent the news of the existence of Earth's civilization back to their mother planet. The large fleet of the Kabang civilization had already set off from their hometown. However, they had not developed stargate technology. The main force had already traveled in the universe at close to the speed of light for a long time, and they were not far away now.

The explorers present had been lurking in the Solar System for many years, and they were just outposts. Although their technology was much more advanced, they still did not dare to rashly come into contact with Earth's civilization. Their mission was to monitor and observe Earth's civilization all day long and guide the main force that followed … Only when the main force arrived would they have sufficient confidence. Whether it was invading or destroying it, they would be able to do it with ease. When the time came, they would consider how to arrange for this surface civilization.

The captain of the Kabang explorers was about to say something, but at this moment, the surveillance radar of the space station suddenly rang with an urgent notification.

"Beep beep beep beep —"

Everyone was stunned and quickly rushed to the screen. They were shocked to see that the readings on it had suddenly become chaotic.

"What's going on?"

The group of Kabang explorers quickly adjusted the equipment. However, the equipment did not have any malfunctions. The various parameters of the outside world that were detected were becoming more and more abnormal, especially the spatial curvature coefficients. There was an astonishing deviation.

At the same time, with Earth's civilization as the center, a large number of spatial folds appeared. The range was spreading outwards at an astonishing speed.

"What kind of phenomenon is this? There are no similar event models in the database! "

Everyone widened their eyes in shock.

Right at this moment, an invisible energy wave suddenly erupted and spread out rapidly into the universe, instantly sweeping through all the planets and the space station they were in. The energy readings instantly broke through the radar's power limit, burning out the radar's equipment.

Everyone was shocked and hurriedly touched their bodies. However, they did not suffer any damage from this energy.

"I've never seen an energy surge of this level before. What exactly happened …"

Just as the group was feeling extremely surprised, the spatial fold phenomenon had already spread to the vicinity of the space station. Through the porthole, they discovered that all the space within their line of sight was distorted and folded like ripples.

From their point of view, it was as if the entire universe had become a stirred quagmire. A torrent of starlight and dark matter was constantly spinning.

Amidst the layers of folds, they seemed to see strange illusions. Countless civilizations and planets that they had never seen before were floating and faintly discernible.

In a daze, they suddenly had an intuition.

— — This universe seems to be about to change.

"Everyone, pay attention! The new version will be released in five minutes. Everyone will work overtime today. Everyone has to log in immediately. I want to check on you, do you hear me? "

Zhu Xiaohua ordered loudly. Seeing that the dozens of employees in the studio responded, he nodded in satisfaction. He turned around and walked into his private office. He closed the door and looked at the new "Galaxy" game cabin in the middle of the room. He rubbed his hands excitedly.

Ever since the Black Star Corps video series with the ID 'Pork Bun Beats Dog' became popular, Zhu Xiaohua's career was on track. He rented a floor as a studio, expanded his business, made a brand, and made a lot of money.

Now that the popularity of "Galaxy" had reached its peak, he placed more importance on this main business. Two days ago, "Galaxy" had entered the version update, and today was the day the update was completed. Version 6.0 would be officially released, and he placed great importance on it. He had already prepared to log in as soon as possible.

Zhu Xiaohua's heart itched when he thought about how the new version would unlock higher levels.

Although the plot of "Galaxy" seemed to be heading toward peace and it was difficult to find any more explosive points, he believed that the players would be the main characters of the stage after "Galaxy". Now that he had unlocked the Calamity Grade, as his level continued to increase, the players who wanted the world to be in chaos would definitely not be able to hold themselves back. They would definitely mess up the situation in the game, spontaneously leading to countless conflicts and interesting exciting stories. This way, there would definitely be no lack of material for videos …

Zhu Xiaohua already had an idea. He planned to adjust the focus of the video and no longer focus on the Black Star Corps. Instead, he would chase after the various collisions between players and NPC forces and make various series and interviews.

Just the thought of having endless material and the possibility of a big sale made him so excited that his bladder tightened.

"I'm going to be rich again this time!"

Zhu Xiaohua was excited as he skillfully laid down in the game cabin. The lid of the cabin closed, and the built-in screen showed the countdown to the completion of the update. He widened his eyes as he watched the time pass second by second. He felt that time was passing too slowly and could not help but shake his legs.

"There are still a few seconds left … Five, four, three, two, one! That's enough! "

The countdown on the built-in screen reached the last second, and it became the login interface. It finally became the version 6.0 that he had been longing for.

Zhu Xiaohua was overjoyed and could not wait to activate the game cabin. He quickly closed his eyes and prepared to enter the game.

However, after waiting for more than a minute with his eyes closed, he did not enter "Galaxy" like before. Zhu Xiaohua was so anxious that he could not help but open his eyes.

"Strange, why can't I log in? Could it be that the game cabin malfunctioned? No way, this was changed two days ago … "

Zhu Xiaohua opened the game cabin in confusion and climbed out again. He squatted down to see if there was a problem with the lid of the game cabin.

However, at this moment, there was a knock on the door. A few employees walked in with helpless expressions.

"Boss, there's a problem. None of us can log in."

"Hmm? So I'm not the only one. Looks like it's not a problem with the game cabin. Have you seen the official website? "

"Yes, it seems like no one can log in."

Hearing this, Zhu Xiaohua was stunned for a moment. He walked to the computer and opened the official website of "Galaxy". He entered the forum and found that a large group of players were posting, but none of them could log in.

"Then it seems like there's a bug in the new version. Maybe there's a problem with the optical computer itself … But it's also strange. No one can log in. For such a big matter, the official website should have issued a statement to explain it. Why is there no movement?"

Zhu Xiaohua flipped through the post and was a little puzzled.

"Why don't you ask?" an employee suggested.

"Oh, that's fine too. I'll ask the official."

Zhu Xiaohua nodded.

He had been invited to attend several professional leagues as a guest, so he had internal channels to contact the official. He could ask about the situation.

Picking up his phone from the table, Zhu Xiaohua opened his social media app and found the official he knew. He was about to send a message to ask.

However, at this moment, there was a commotion outside the office, mixed with cries of surprise.

"What's going on outside? Why is it so noisy?"

Zhu Xiaohua frowned and stopped editing the message. He walked out of the office in large strides and saw that all the employees were gathered in front of the window, looking up as if they were looking at something.

"What are you looking at? Why aren't you returning to your posts … Hmm?"

Zhu Xiaohua was a little dissatisfied. He strode over and also went to the window. He subconsciously looked out and suddenly paused.

On the road outside the window, all the pedestrians stopped and looked at the sky. On the balconies and windows of every floor of the surrounding buildings, there were people who stuck their heads out. They also maintained the posture of looking up at the sky. Everyone's faces were filled with shock.

Seeing this strange scene, Zhu Xiaohua's heart tightened. He slowly raised his head and looked at the sky.

Evening had just passed, and night had just fallen. A resplendent galaxy had already appeared in the sky. More stars lit up in the night sky. The stars were like a waterfall, hanging upside down in the Milky Way. They were swaying and spinning, and the sky seemed to have turned into a vortex. It was completely distorted, as if someone was stirring the sky.

"This, this is …"

Zhu Xiaohua stared at this scene in a daze, his mouth wide open.

Just as everyone was dumbfounded, spatial ripples suddenly appeared in the sky. Interstellar fleets appeared out of thin air one after another, as if they had always been there, instantly attracting the attention of everyone on the ground.

Zhu Xiaohua also looked over, but his eyes suddenly widened as he stared blankly at the identical emblem on the outer armor of these battleships … This emblem was too familiar, and he recognized it at a glance.

Before anyone could react, an even more familiar figure suddenly appeared in the air. As if waking up from a deep sleep, he slowly opened his eyes.

The expression of this figure slowly turned from confusion to surprise, and in the end, it turned into nostalgia. His lips moved slightly.

"Hometown, I'm back …"

Although he was far away, for some reason, his voice seemed to ignore the distance and sounded in the hearts of everyone who was looking at him.

At this moment, Zhu Xiaohua, like all the employees around him, felt as if he had fallen into an ice cellar. His face was filled with confusion, and his mind was blank.

At this moment, the figure in the sky seemed to have sensed the aura of a familiar person. He lowered his head and looked over. Across the distant night sky, his gaze met Zhu Xiaohua's from afar, and he revealed a playful smile.

Zhu Xiaohua instantly woke up from his dream and shuddered. He took large strides back in disbelief and tripped over the table and chair, collapsing to the ground with a thud.

His eyes almost popped out of their sockets, and there was only thick disbelief on his face. His lips trembled, and his voice unconsciously rose as he cried out involuntarily,

"Black Star, Black Star, Black Star … Black Star?!"

…

On this day, the world welcomed a drastic change.

Countless illusions that should have disappeared in the long river of history reappeared.

Some people called it "Invasion of the Entire Realm", while others called it "Turning Point of Fate".

Some people felt that this was a turtledove taking over a magpie's nest, while others felt that this was spreading out.

Some people thought that this was the beginning of the end, while others thought that this was the continuation of life.

However, no matter what their opinion was, everything that happened on this day was remembered by countless people and opened a new era.

—

(End of the main text)

(End of this chapter)
